# Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Gateway Fiber — Compact 10G Cloud Gateway

**Category:** Networking gear (Cloud Gateway / Router)

**MSRP:** $279.00 (base, no storage)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Processor | Quad-core ARM Cortex-A73 @ 2.2 GHz |
| System Memory | 3 GB |
| Storage | Selectable NVMe SSD up to 2TB (drive tray required for self-installed drives) |
| WAN Ports | 1x 10G SFP+, 1x 10GbE RJ45 (default); max WAN port count of 6 configurable |
| LAN Ports | 1x 10G SFP+, 4x 2.5GbE RJ45 (one with PoE+) |
| Switch | Integrated 4-port 2.5GbE switch |
| IDS/IPS Throughput | 5 Gbps, with 55,000+ signatures via CyberSecure |
| PoE Budget | 30W, voltage range 50–57V |
| Power | 54V DC/1.1A external adapter (included), 100–240V AC input, 29.4W max consumption (excl. PoE) |
| Managed Devices | 50+ UniFi devices, 50 access hubs, 500+ simultaneous users |
| Managed Cameras | 15 HD / 8 2K / 5 4K |
| UniFi App Suite | Network, Protect, Access, Talk, Connect |
| Networking Features | Multi-WAN load balancing, OSPF/BGP dynamic routing, advanced QoS, mDNS, advanced NAT, integrated RADIUS + RadSec, virtual network override |
| VPN/SD-WAN | License-free SD-WAN, Site Magic site-to-site, IPsec, WireGuard, OpenVPN, L2TP, Identity Endpoint One-Click VPN, Teleport zero-config VPN |
| Firewall/Security | Stateful firewall, Layer 7 app-aware firewall, DPI & traffic ID, zone-based filtering, content filtering, ad blocking |
| Display | 0.96" status LCM display |
| Management | Ethernet, Bluetooth |
| Dimensions | 212.8 x 127.6 x 30 mm (8.4 x 5 x 1.2") |
| Weight | 675g (1.5 lb) without SSD; 734g (1.6 lb) with SSD |
| Enclosure | Polycarbonate |
| Operating Temp | 0–40°C (32–104°F), 5–95% noncondensing humidity |
| Certifications | CE, FCC, IC, SRRC, Anatel, NDAA compliant |

## Notable Features

- Ships with dual 10G SFP+ ports plus a 10GbE RJ45, making it well suited to fiber ISP hand-offs (SFP+ ONTs) while still supporting copper WAN
- Highest IDS/IPS throughput (5 Gbps) in Ubiquiti's compact gateway lineup, roughly 50% faster than the UDM-SE despite costing about half as much
- NVMe storage slot (PCIe Gen 4) enables UniFi Protect NVR functionality without an external NAS
- Non-Wi-Fi console — no built-in AP, so it pairs with standalone UniFi access points (e.g. U7 Pro)
- Full UniFi application suite support (Network, Protect, Access, Talk, Connect) on a single box
